note: Both sets share two factual errors: misreading the system voltage as '0/240 V' instead of '120/240V' and hallucinating a 'Current Organizer' connection. Set A includes invented quotes (e.g., '1 -> 150') and trivial duplicate claims (Voltage Sensor, Circuit 50 material), reducing its quality. Set B provides significantly better coverage, correctly extracting metadata (Copyright, Checked By), more revision history entries, and additional circuit details (20, 32) that Set A misses, despite minor OCR typos in some quotes.
